name: Bleelblep's Revenge Next Plugins
description: Revenge Next ports of bleelblep/revengeplugins, built from this repository.

bleelblep.ai-core.name: AI Core
bleelblep.ai-core.description: Shared AI key, spending cap and request queue for plugins that use AI. Does nothing on its own.
bleelblep.ai-core.author: bleelblep, Rosie

bleelblep.ansi-colours.name: ANSI Colours
bleelblep.ansi-colours.description: Shows colours in ANSI code blocks the way desktop Discord does.
bleelblep.ansi-colours.author: bleelblep

bleelblep.catch-up.name: Catch Up
bleelblep.catch-up.description: Run /catchup for a short summary of what you missed in a channel. Needs AI Core.
bleelblep.catch-up.author: bleelblep

bleelblep.char-counter.name: Character Counter
bleelblep.char-counter.description: Shows how many characters your message has, in a small square above the message box.
bleelblep.char-counter.author: bleelblep

bleelblep.custom-timestamps.name: Custom Timestamps
bleelblep.custom-timestamps.description: Choose how chat timestamps look: calendar, relative, ISO 8601 or your own format.
bleelblep.custom-timestamps.author: bleelblep, Fiery

bleelblep.dreamscape.name: Dreamscape
bleelblep.dreamscape.description: Liquid glass, holographic avatars, reality tears, gesture spells and AI-designed channel atmospheres.
bleelblep.dreamscape.author: bleelblep

bleelblep.free-stickers.name: Free Stickers
bleelblep.free-stickers.description: Send any sticker without Nitro; locked ones go as an image link.
bleelblep.free-stickers.author: bleelblep

bleelblep.ghost-log-native-beta.name: Ghost Log Native Beta
bleelblep.ghost-log-native-beta.description: Beta of Ghost Log with encrypted storage and backups. The testing track for Ghost Log.
bleelblep.ghost-log-native-beta.author: bleelblep

bleelblep.hide-call-buttons.name: Hide Call Buttons
bleelblep.hide-call-buttons.description: Hides call and video buttons from DMs, user profiles and voice channels.
bleelblep.hide-call-buttons.author: John (janisslsm), bleelblep

bleelblep.hide-servers-drawer.name: Hide Servers
bleelblep.hide-servers-drawer.description: Hide servers or whole folders from your server list, only on your device.
bleelblep.hide-servers-drawer.author: bleelblep, blerp

bleelblep.live-markdown.name: Live Markdown
bleelblep.live-markdown.description: Shows bold, italics, code, spoilers and more styled as you type a message.
bleelblep.live-markdown.author: bleelblep

bleelblep.no-dividers.name: No Dividers
bleelblep.no-dividers.description: Removes the thin lines between rows in settings and other lists.
bleelblep.no-dividers.author: bleelblep

bleelblep.picture-links.name: Picture Links
bleelblep.picture-links.description: Tap profile pictures and banners to view them full size, with save and share.
bleelblep.picture-links.author: bleelblep

bleelblep.plugin-hub.name: Plugin Hub
bleelblep.plugin-hub.description: A Plugin Hub section in Discord's settings with shortcuts to the plugins you choose.
bleelblep.plugin-hub.author: bleelblep

bleelblep.review-db.name: ReviewDB
bleelblep.review-db.description: Read and write reviews on user profiles and servers, from ReviewDB.
bleelblep.review-db.author: bleelblep

bleelblep.scenes.name: Scenes
bleelblep.scenes.description: Living atmospheres for Discord: aurora, nebula, underwater light, rain, embers, enchanted light, Halloween, Thanksgiving and Christmas. Built-in GPU shaders, entirely offline.
bleelblep.scenes.author: bleelblep

bleelblep.screenshot-redactor-legacy.name: Screenshot Redactor (Legacy)
bleelblep.screenshot-redactor-legacy.description: Screenshot Redactor for Discord before version 347. On newer versions, use Screenshot Redactor.
bleelblep.screenshot-redactor-legacy.author: bleelblep

bleelblep.screenshot-redactor.name: Screenshot Redactor
bleelblep.screenshot-redactor.description: Swaps names, avatars and personal details for placeholders so chats are safe to screenshot.
bleelblep.screenshot-redactor.author: bleelblep

bleelblep.second-thoughts.name: Second Thoughts
bleelblep.second-thoughts.description: Stops passwords, API keys and card numbers from being sent. Optional AI checks with AI Core.
bleelblep.second-thoughts.author: bleelblep

bleelblep.send-tweaks.name: Send Tweaks
bleelblep.send-tweaks.description: Strips link tracking, rewrites links, sends silently and applies your own find-and-replace rules.
bleelblep.send-tweaks.author: bleelblep, Rosie

bleelblep.show-tag.name: Show Tag
bleelblep.show-tag.description: Shows usernames next to display names in chat, including in replies.
bleelblep.show-tag.author: Cynosphere, bleelblep

bleelblep.staff-tags.name: Staff Tags
bleelblep.staff-tags.description: Shows extra tags for staff members — OWNER, ADMIN, STAFF, MOD, VC Mod, Chat Mod, WEBHOOK.
bleelblep.staff-tags.author: bleelblep, Fiery

bleelblep.tldr.name: TL;DR
bleelblep.tldr.description: Long-press a long message for a short summary only you can see. Needs AI Core.
bleelblep.tldr.author: bleelblep

bleelblep.translate.name: Translate
bleelblep.translate.description: Translate messages in place with a long-press, using free services. No key or account needed.
bleelblep.translate.author: bleelblep

bleelblep.veil.name: Veil
bleelblep.veil.description: Blur messages from chosen people, channels or keywords like spoilers, and tap to reveal.
bleelblep.veil.author: bleelblep
